{{Current events|year=2019|month=10|day=3|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Paris police headquarters stabbing]] 
**A man stabs five people at the central police headquarters in the [[France|French]] capital of [[Paris]], killing three officers and an administrative worker. The attacker, who was shot dead by other officers, was an admin worker at the station. [https://www.bbc.com/news/49921145 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*The [[Marine Accident Investigation Branch]] of the [[UK Department for Transport]] issues a report on the grounding of cargo vessel MV ''Priscilla'' on the [[Pentland Skerries]] off the coast of [[Shetland]], [[Scotland]]. The investigation concludes the lone crewmember on the bridge was distracted by watching [[music video]]s during the nighttime accident. The grounding triggered changes in procedures by the [[Maritime and Coastguard Agency]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-highlands-islands-49911746 (BBC)]
*Three people are killed and three others injured in a plane crash at [[Capital Region International Airport]] in [[Lansing, Michigan]]. [https://www.wnem.com/news/dead-injured-from-small-plane-crash-at-capital-region-airport/article_da2f87ca-e5e1-11e9-8442-7bef85ce3a72.html (WNEM-TV)], [https://www.wlns.com/news/local-news/breaking-small-plane-crashes-at-capital-region-airport/ (WLNS-TV)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 United States outbreak of lung illness linked to vaping products]]
**The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] announces that the number of deaths caused by [[vaping-associated pulmonary injury]] ("vaping illness") linked to [[electronic cigarette]]s has risen to 18, with an additional 1,080 injuries reported. The CDC says the cause is still under investigation. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/10/03/mayo-clinic-vaping-study-chemical-fumes-blame-lung-illnesses/3850859002/ (''USA Today'')] 

;Law and crime
*A shooting in [[Vancouver, Washington]], [[United States]] leaves at least one dead, and several more injured. [https://www.columbian.com/news/2019/oct/03/shots-fired-at-smith-tower-in-vancouver/ (The Columbian)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Foreign interference in the 2020 United States elections]]
**Amid an [[Impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump|impeachment inquiry]] against him, [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says "[[China]] should start an investigation" into [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|presidential candidate]] [[Joe Biden]]. Chair of the [[Federal Election Commission]] [[Ellen Weintraub]] again explains that "it is illegal for any person to solicit, accept, or receive anything of value from a foreign national in connection with a U.S. election". [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/trump-publicly-urges-china-ukraine-investigate-bidens-amid-impeachment-inquiry-n1061956 (NBC News)]
**Sources for ''[[The New York Times]]'' allege that two American diplomats presented a statement for [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] to sign wherein [[Ukraine]] would commit to investigate Joe Biden and his son [[Hunter Biden]]. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/nyt-vs-wilden-oekraine-onderzoek-naar-biden-opdringen~a936917d/ (ANP via ''Het Laatste Nieuws'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/10/03/us/politics/trump-ukraine.html (''The New York Times'')]
